{{small|(Round 2, Puskás Akadémia–Kisvárda)}} | attendance = 227,842 | average attendance = 4,299 | prevseason = [[2025–26 Nemzeti Bajnokság I|2025–26]] | nextseason = ''2027–28'' | updated = 11 October 2026, Round 9 (6 of 6 matches) }} The '''2026–27 Nemzeti Bajnokság I''' (also known as 2026–27 '''OTP Bank Liga'''), also known as '''NB I''', is the 128th season of top-tier football in Hungary. The league was officially named ''[[OTP Bank]] Liga'' for sponsorship reasons.{{#invoke:cite|news |url=https://szovetseg.mlsz.hu/hir/visszater-az-otp-bank-liga |title=Visszatér az OTP Bank Liga |trans-title=The OTP Bank League returns |publisher=MLSZ ([[Hungarian Football Federation]]) |website=mlsz.hu |date=10 June 2026 |language=hu}} The season began on 24 July 2026 and is scheduled to end on 23 May 2027. [[Győri ETO FC|Győr]] are entering the season as the defending champions, having won their 5th title last season. Starting with the 2026–27 season, the last-placed team in the Nemzeti Bajnokság I is automatically relegated, while the second-last placed team enters a one-legged relegation play-off against the runners-up of the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság II]]. The match is played at a neutral venue, preferably situated at a similar distance from both clubs, with the winner securing a place in the following season's Nemzeti Bajnokság I. The venue must also satisfy the requirements for the use of the [[Video assistant referee|VAR]] system.{{Cite web|url=https://index.hu/sport/futball/2026/04/15/labdarugo-nb-i-2026-2027-szabalyvaltoztatas-mlsz-osztalyozo/|title=Drasztikus változtatás jön a magyar labdarúgásban a következő idénytől|trans-title=Drastic changes are coming to Hungarian football starting next season|date=15 April 2026|website=index.hu|language=hu|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260416110601/https://index.hu/sport/futball/2026/04/15/labdarugo-nb-i-2026-2027-szabalyvaltoztatas-mlsz-osztalyozo/|archive-date=16 April 2026|access-date=1 June 2026}} ==Teams== ===Changes=== Twelve teams are competing in the league – the top ten teams from the previous season and the two teams promoted from the [[2025–26 Nemzeti Bajnokság II|Nemzeti Bajnokság II]]. The promoted teams are [[Vasas SC|Vasas]] and [[Kispest-Honvéd FC|Kispest-Honvéd]], who returned to the top flight after respective absences of three years. They replaced [[Diósgyőri VTK|Diósgyőr]] and [[Kazincbarcikai SC|Kazincbarcika]], who were relegated to the [[2026–27 Nemzeti Bajnokság II|Nemzeti Bajnokság II]] after respective spells of three and one years in the top flight. {| class="wikitable" ! {{increase}} from [[2025–26 Nemzeti Bajnokság II]] ! {{decrease}} to [[2026–27 Nemzeti Bajnokság II]] |- |[[Vasas SC|Vasas]] (promoted after a three-year absence)
